result.document_summary: A mid-document excerpt of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 1 (General Provisions) covering code enforcement mediation, reinspection fees, code enforcement liens and recovery of abatement costs, as rendered on a code-publisher web page.
result.notes: Although the page URL points to San Diego's Division 11 (prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price fixing, "Use and sale of algorithmic devices prohibited"), this part of the document contains only general code-enforcement provisions (mediation, reinspection fees, code enforcement liens, abatement cost recovery). None of this text concerns rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting, so no in-scope rules are extracted. The algorithmic rent-setting text itself is not in this part and no bill-page exception applies.
